question: Should OpenClaw accept this repaired curated OpenRouter `/images` model table now, or defer the remaining OpenRouter image-model work to the broader catalog policy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/91504?
rationale: The implementation can be mechanically repaired, but choosing a static curated model table versus broader dynamic catalog discovery is a provider-surface product decision with compatibility and maintenance cost.

options.title: Accept curated list after repair
options.body: Rebase and refresh the capability table, keep existing preview/default refs compatible, and leave dynamic discovery to the linked broader issue.

options.title: Defer to broader catalog policy
options.body: Close or pause this PR and keep the remaining work under the broader OpenRouter image-model support issue.

options.title: Narrow to the Microsoft example
options.body: Limit this PR to the originally reported Microsoft model plus the minimum `/images` routing needed for it.

recommendation.title: Accept curated list after repair
recommendation.body: Rebase and refresh the capability table, keep existing preview/default refs compatible, and leave dynamic discovery to the linked broader issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main work owns the shared image capability limit behavior this PR must preserve before the product decision is actionable.
